proposals.evidence: CDIAL 9459 bhāra gives Punjabi/Lahnda bhārā heavy and western Pahari bhārā. Dogri pārə fits the regional devoiced onset and final schwa alongside those adjective forms. The onset comparison is regional, not an assertion that Turner quotes this exact Dogri response. Local Indo-Aryan transmission remains unresolved. Exact response: pārə.
